claim.summary: Interrupted tool recovery must replay only when BOTH the persisted call policy and the current tool declaration are replay-safe and the run was not cancelled; otherwise it must publish an interrupted outcome that preserves the durable checkpoint without clearing it or invoking the tool.

validation.notes: Fault: recoverToolInvocation gated safe replay on `!cancelled && (call.replay === "safe" || tool?.replay === "safe")`, so a lone safe persisted call policy or a lone safe current tool declaration replayed an interrupted effect. Fixed minimally to `!cancelled && call.replay === "safe" && tool?.replay === "safe"`, matching packages/agent/docs/tool-durability.md ('both the stored and current declarations are replay: "safe"'; 'If the current tool declaration is missing or no longer safe, use unsafe interruption recovery'). The regression script loads the real module through .prale-eval/subject.mjs and asserts the observable boundary event sequence: mismatched, absent (undefined), unannotated (null) and cancelled cases must be exactly ['read','publish'] with isError true, checkpoint content/details preserved, terminate false and the interruption marker appended, proving the checkpoint is not cleared and the tool is not invoked; the doubly safe, non-cancelled case must be exactly ['clear','invoke','effect-complete','publish'] with the real result. Verified red/green: with the original `||` predicate restored the script exits 1 with an assertion (events were clear,invoke,effect-complete,publish); with the fix it exits 0. Dependency limitation: repository vitest suites (packages/agent `vitest --run` on test/harness/runtime/drive-tools.test.ts) cannot run here because node_modules is absent and installing dependencies is out of scope, so the standalone Node regression is the primary validation; the production change is a single boolean-operator fix with no API or type changes.
